_**Agent (claude-opus-4-8 2026-06-22 20:22:28Z)**_

`ryzenadj` 的 `power-limit` 系列選項是**設定（寫入）**，不是測量。它們是 *limit*，用來改 APU 的功耗上限，例如：

- `--stapm-limit` (STAPM, 長期平均)
- `--fast-limit` (PPT fast)
- `--slow-limit` (PPT slow)
- `--tctl-temp`、`--vrm-current` (TDC)、`--vrmmax-current` (EDC) 等

這些都是「告訴 SoC 你最多可以吃多少瓦」，不是讀數。

## 要「讀」當前功耗用 `-i` / `--info`

```bash
sudo ryzenadj -i
```

輸出裡會看到類似：

```
| PPT LIMIT       | 15.000 | W |   ← 這是設定的上限
| PPT VALUE       |  6.231 | W |   ← 這才是「當前實際功耗」
| STAPM LIMIT ... |
| STAPM VALUE ... |
```

`*_VALUE` 欄位才是當下的即時量測值。

## 重要限制

⚠️ 它量的是 **APU / SoC package 的功耗**（CPU + 內顯那顆晶片），**不是整塊主板 / 整機的 power usage**。主板上的 DRAM、獨顯、風扇、外接裝置、VRM 損耗都不在內。

如果你要的是「整機/主板牆插功耗」，得用別的方式：

- **外接功率計**（如 wattmeter / 智慧插座）量牆插總功耗 — 最準
- `powerstat`（從電池 ACPI 讀，僅筆電且非充電狀態）
- `turbostat`（Intel；AMD 支援有限）
- RAPL `/sys/class/powercap/`（也是 package 級，非整機）

所以結論：**`power-limit` 不能測量，要測量請用 `ryzenadj -i` 看 `*_VALUE`，而且只涵蓋 APU 那顆晶片，不是整塊主板。**

需要我幫你寫個小腳本定期 poll `ryzenadj -i` 抓 PPT VALUE 做監控嗎？

```text
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# cpu-crashtest.sh — controlled CPU load to reproduce/confirm the load-induced
# instant power-off. Runs an all-core load for DURATION seconds while printing
# temp/load/power, so you can verify whether a fix (outlet/UPS/EPS reseat/BIOS)
# actually stopped the crashes.
#
#   >>> SAVE ALL WORK FIRST. If the machine is still faulty it WILL hard power-off. <<<
#
# Usage:  ~/.local/bin/cpu-crashtest.sh [seconds]   (default 180)
set -u
DUR="${1:-180}"
N="$(nproc)"

tctl() { for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do
  [ "$(cat "$h/name" 2>/dev/null)" = k10temp ] || continue
  for f in "$h"/temp*_label; do [ "$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null)" = Tctl ] && { echo $(( $(cat "${f%_label}_input")/1000 )); return; }; done
done; echo "?"; }

echo ">>> SAVE YOUR WORK. Stressing $N cores for ${DUR}s. Ctrl-C aborts. $(date) <<<"
sleep 3

if command -v stress-ng >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "engine: stress-ng matrixprod (heaviest)"
  stress-ng --cpu "$N" --cpu-method matrixprod --timeout "${DUR}s" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
else
  echo "engine: sha256sum workers (install stress-ng for a heavier AVX load)"
  for _ in $(seq 1 "$N"); do timeout "$DUR" sha256sum /dev/zero >/dev/null 2>&1 & done
fi

start=$SECONDS
while [ $((SECONDS-start)) -lt "$DUR" ]; do
  printf "  t+%-3ss  Tctl=%sC  load=%s  gpuW=%s\n" \
    "$((SECONDS-start))" "$(tctl)" "$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" \
    "$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
  sleep 5
done
wait 2>/dev/null
echo ">>> SURVIVED ${DUR}s with no power cut — fix looks good. $(date) <<<"
echo "    (review trend any time:  tail -40 ~/blackbox/sensors.csv )"
=== diff with ~/cpu-crashtest.sh ===
```

Read blackbox logger script

`cat ~/.local/bin/blackbox-logger.sh`

```text
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# blackbox-logger: append a sensor/power/load snapshot every INTERVAL seconds.
# Purpose: forensic trail to diagnose hard power-off crashes that leave no logs.
# The file is fsync'd each tick so the last samples survive an instant power cut.
# Resolves hwmon chips BY NAME because /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN indices are NOT
# stable across reboots.
set -u
INTERVAL="${INTERVAL:-10}"
OUT="${OUT:-$HOME/blackbox/sensors.csv}"
WIDE="${WIDE:-$HOME/blackbox/wide.csv}"   # long-format dump of EVERY hwmon input
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"

hwmon_by_name() {            # echo first hwmon dir whose name == $1
  local want="$1" h n
  for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do
    n=$(cat "$h/name" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    [ "$n" = "$want" ] && { echo "$h"; return 0; }
  done
  return 1
}

temp_by_label() {           # echo temp*_input (millideg) whose label == $2 in dir $1
  local dir="$1" want="$2" f lbl
  [ -n "$dir" ] || return 1
  for f in "$dir"/temp*_label; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    lbl=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$lbl" = "$want" ] && { cat "${f%_label}_input" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }
  done
  return 1
}

md() { local v="${1:-}"; [ -n "$v" ] && echo $((v/1000)) || echo ""; }

[ -s "$OUT" ] || echo "ts,uptime_s,tctl_c,tccd1_c,tccd2_c,asus_max_c,amdgpu_c,nvme_max_c,gpu_c,gpu_w,load1,mem_used_mb,xkeysnail_restarts" >> "$OUT"
echo "# start $(date -Is) uptime=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/uptime) kernel=$(uname -r)" >> "$OUT"

while true; do
  ts=$(date -Is)
  up=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/uptime)

  k10=$(hwmon_by_name k10temp || true)
  tctl=$(md "$(temp_by_label "$k10" Tctl || true)")
  tccd1=$(md "$(temp_by_label "$k10" Tccd1 || true)")
  tccd2=$(md "$(temp_by_label "$k10" Tccd2 || true)")

  amd=$(hwmon_by_name amdgpu || true)
  amdg=$(md "$(temp_by_label "$amd" edge || true)")

  # max temp across the asus WMI chip (board/VRM/chipset) and across all nvme
  asusmax=""; nvmemax=""
  for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do
    nm=$(cat "$h/name" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    case "$nm" in
      asus|nvme) : ;;
      *) continue ;;
    esac
    for f in "$h"/temp*_input; do
      [ -e "$f" ] || continue
      v=$(( $(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) / 1000 ))
      [ "$v" -le 0 ] && continue
      if [ "$nm" = nvme ]; then
        { [ -z "$nvmemax" ] || [ "$v" -gt "$nvmemax" ]; } && nvmemax=$v
      else
        { [ -z "$asusmax" ] || [ "$v" -gt "$asusmax" ]; } && asusmax=$v
      fi
    done
  done

  gpu_c=""; gpu_w=""
  if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    read -r gpu_c gpu_w < <(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,power.draw \
        --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d ' ' | tr ',' ' ')
  fi

  load1=$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/loadavg)
  mem_used=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/{print $3}')
  xk=$(systemctl show xkeysnail -p NRestarts --value 2>/dev/null || true)

  echo "$ts,$up,$tctl,$tccd1,$tccd2,$asusmax,$amdg,$nvmemax,${gpu_c:-},${gpu_w:-},$load1,$mem_used,${xk:-}" >> "$OUT"

  # wide long-format dump: every temp(millideg)/voltage(milliV)/fan(rpm)/power(uW)
  # input from every hwmon chip. Auto-captures VRM temp & 12V rail voltages as
  # soon as a board-sensor module (asus_ec_sensors / nct6775) is loaded.
  [ -s "$WIDE" ] || echo "ts,chip,sensor,label,raw" >> "$WIDE"
  for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do
    cn=$(cat "$h/name" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    for f in "$h"/temp*_input "$h"/in*_input "$h"/fan*_input "$h"/power*_input "$h"/power*_average; do
      [ -e "$f" ] || continue
      bn=$(basename "$f"); key="${bn%_input}"; key="${key%_average}"
      lbl=$(cat "$h/${key}_label" 2>/dev/null)
      echo "$ts,$cn,$bn,${lbl:-},$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null)" >> "$WIDE"
    done
  done

  sync -d "$OUT" "$WIDE" 2>/dev/null || sync
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
done
```
</details></tool-use>

調查清楚了。給你一個完整的判斷:

## 1. 現有 setup 已經很完整 ✅

`~/.local/bin/blackbox-logger.sh`(systemd `--user` service,跑了 14h,每 10s `fsync`)已經在記錄黑盒,而且做得很好:
- CPU 溫度 (Tctl / Tccd1 / Tccd2)、主板/VRM 溫度 (nct6799、asus)、NVMe 溫度
- **GPU 功耗**(nvidia-smi + amdgpu PPT `power1_input`)
- `wide.csv` 已經把 **每個 hwmon 的電壓 rail** (`nct6799 in*_input`,含 Vcore/3.3V/5V/12V 分壓) 全抓下來了
- 風扇 RPM、load、mem

`cpu-crashtest.sh` 則是用來「壓力測試重現 + 驗證修好」。這套設計是對的。

## 2. ⚠️ ryzenadj 這條路放棄 — 它不適合你這台

- **沒裝**,而且**裝了也沒用**:你這台是 **桌機版 Ryzen**(`k10temp` + ASUS `nct6799` super-IO)。`ryzenadj` 是給**筆電 APU**(Renoir/Cezanne 那類 mobile)的,桌機 Ryzen 上 `PPT VALUE` 基本讀不出有意義的值。
- 桌機讀 **CPU 封裝功耗**的正解是 **RAPL**:`/sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0`(`package-0`,在 AMD 上就是 CPU 整顆)。

## 3. 資料其實已經有線索 🔥

06-22 那次自動關機前最後幾筆(最後 fsync 的一行是 13:25:16,然後 13:35:00 才重開機 uptime=10):

```
13:24:45  Tctl=93  Tccd=75/77  load=8
13:24:55  Tctl=95  Tccd=76/76  load=15
13:25:16  Tctl=95  Tccd=75/76  load=10.5   ← 最後一筆,之後直接斷電
```

**負載下 Tctl 飆到 95°C 然後瞬斷** —— 典型的「load-induced instant power-off」。95°C 是 AMD Tjmax,正常只會降頻不會關機,所以瞬斷更像是 **EPS 12V / VRM 過流保護 (OCP) 跳掉**,或散熱/供電問題。要釘死是哪個,缺的就是下一點。

## 4. 唯一的缺口 = CPU 封裝功耗 (W)

黑盒現在只有 GPU 功耗,**沒有 CPU 功耗**。瞬斷的關鍵就是「crash 當下 CPU 瓦數 + 12V rail 電壓」的相關性。RAPL 能補,但 `energy_uj` 被 root 鎖(Platypus CVE-2020-8694 緩解),所以 `--user` 的 logger 現在讀不到(剛測 = `DENIED`)。

補法兩步:
1. **udev rule**(需 sudo,開放 RAPL 讀取):
   ```
   /etc/udev/rules.d/99-rapl.rules
   SUBSYSTEM=="powercap", ACTION=="add", RUN+="/bin/chmod -R a+r /sys/devices/virtual/powercap"
   ```
2. **logger 加一個 `cpu_w` 欄位**:用 `intel-rapl:0/energy_uj` 兩次取樣算差除以間隔 → 瓦數。

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One-time: make RAPL energy counters readable by the --user blackbox-logger so
# it can record CPU package watts. Run with sudo:  sudo blackbox-enable-rapl.sh
set -e
cat > /etc/udev/rules.d/99-rapl.rules <<'EOF'
# Make RAPL energy counters readable by non-root (blackbox-logger CPU watts).
# energy_uj is root-only since the Platypus mitigation (CVE-2020-8694).
SUBSYSTEM=="powercap", ACTION=="add", RUN+="/bin/chmod -R a+r /sys/devices/virtual/powercap"
EOF
udevadm control --reload-rules
udevadm trigger --subsystem-match=powercap
chmod -R a+r /sys/devices/virtual/powercap   # take effect this boot, no reboot
echo "udev rule installed. Verifying user read access:"
sudo -u "${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" cat /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/energy_uj >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && echo "OK: energy_uj readable -> cpu_w will populate after logger restart" \
  || echo "STILL DENIED (check the path / driver)"

```

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# blackbox-analyze: scan sensors.csv for power-off events and print the forensic
# window around each one. A crash is inferred when uptime_s drops between two
# consecutive samples (machine rebooted) OR a "# start uptime=<low>" marker
# follows real data. For each event it prints the last N rows before the cut
# (the actual crash moment, fsync'd) so you can eyeball temp / cpu_w / vcore.
#
# Usage: blackbox-analyze.sh [csv] [pre_rows]   (defaults: ~/blackbox/sensors.csv 8)
set -u
CSV="${1:-$HOME/blackbox/sensors.csv}"
PRE="${2:-8}"
[ -r "$CSV" ] || { echo "no csv: $CSV" >&2; exit 1; }

awk -F, -v PRE="$PRE" '
  function flush(reason,   i,n) {
    n=0; for(i in buf) n++
    if(n==0) return
    print "\n=== POWER-OFF inferred ("reason") ==="
    print "  last sample before cut: " last_ts "  (uptime " last_up "s)"
    print "  ts                          up_s  Tctl Tccd1 Tccd2 amdgpu nvme  load   cpu_w  vcore"
    s = (head>PRE)? head-PRE : 0
    for(i=s;i<head;i++) printf "  %s\n", buf[i]
  }
  /^# start/ {
    # extract uptime= from the marker
    for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){}
    m=$0; sub(/.*uptime=/,"",m); sub(/ .*/,"",m)
    if(seen && m+0 < (last_up+0)) flush("reboot marker uptime="m)
    next
  }
  /^#/ { next }
  /^ts,/ { next }            # header
  NF<12 { next }
  {
    up=$2+0
    if(seen && up < last_up-2) flush("uptime reset "last_up"->"up)   # -2 slack
    # build a compact display row
    row=sprintf("%-27s %6s  %3s  %4s  %4s   %4s  %3s  %5s  %5s  %5s", \
                $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$7,$8,$11,($14==""?"-":$14),($15==""?"-":$15))
    buf[head]=row; head++
    last_ts=$1; last_up=up; seen=1
  }
  END { print "\n(scan complete; "head" data samples; current session still running — no trailing cut)" }
' "$CSV"

```

Done. Everything is wired and verified working. Here's the wrap-up.

## What I changed (all in `~/.local/bin/`, ad-hoc, not chezmoi-managed)

| Script | Change |
|---|---|
| `blackbox-logger.sh` | **+`cpu_w`** (RAPL `intel-rapl:0` energy-delta → CPU package watts, with counter-wrap handling) and **+`vcore_v`** (nct6799 `in0`), appended at end of each row. Self-documents schema + RAPL readability on each start. |
| `blackbox-enable-rapl.sh` | **new** — one-time udev rule to unlock RAPL for the `--user` service (needs sudo). |
| `blackbox-analyze.sh` | **new** — scans `sensors.csv`, finds every power-off (uptime reset / low-uptime boot marker) and prints the fsync'd pre-crash window. |

Logger already restarted on the new 15-col schema — `vcore_v` is logging live (1.25–1.28 V, healthy). `cpu_w` is blank until you do the one sudo step below.

## ⚠️ One step left — you run it (this session has no TTY for sudo)

Type this in the prompt with the `!` prefix:

```
! sudo ~/.local/bin/blackbox-enable-rapl.sh && systemctl --user restart blackbox-logger.service
```

After that `cpu_w` will populate every tick (survives reboot via the udev rule).

## What the existing data already tells us 🔎

The 06-22 auto-power-off, from `blackbox-analyze.sh`:

```
13:24:04  Tctl=95  load=28.2   ← sustained all-core load
13:24:55  Tctl=95  load=35.6
13:25:16  Tctl=95  load=34.9   ← last fsync'd sample, then instant cut
```

**Tctl pinned at 93–95°C (= AMD Tjmax) under load ~30 for over a minute, then instant power-off.** GPU/NVMe temps were fine (51/58°C). This is textbook **load-induced cutoff**. 95°C alone normally just throttles, so the prime suspects are **EPS-12V / VRM over-current protection tripping** or **cooling/mount + power-delivery** — which is exactly why we just added CPU watts. Next crash (or `cpu-crashtest.sh` run) will show whether watts spike right before the cut.

## Diagnosis loop from here

1. Run the sudo step above → `cpu_w` live.
2. Reproduce: `~/.local/bin/cpu-crashtest.sh 180` (save work first — it may hard-cut).
3. Inspect: `~/.local/bin/blackbox-analyze.sh` after any cut — now with watts + Vcore in the window.
4. Watch live: `tail -f ~/blackbox/sensors.csv`.

On `ryzenadj`: confirmed the wrong tool here (desktop Ryzen, not a mobile APU) — RAPL is the right power source and is now plumbed in.
